d: Was Australia's Test match scandal - 'Sandpapergate' really just about three players? David Warner's latest comments have reopened old wounds in Australian cricket, backing Usman Khawaja's account of what happened during the 2018 ball-tampering scandal. With Cricket Australia's original findings back under scrutiny, Rupha Ramani examines whether Australian cricket ever fully confronted the culture behind Sandpapergate and what does this line up for Pat Cummins and co.
